reviews.title: Chart Inaccurate
reviews.text: What’s frustrating is I love the layout and features of this app — but when I put in my info, it got my chart all wrong besides my sun sign. This isn’t the second or even the third or fourth app/website I’ve used to map my astrological chart, I’ve been studying my chart for nearly a decade by now, and it’s never looked anything like what’s been calculated here. Deeply confused and a bit disappointed, because otherwise this would be my new go to app for astrology :(

reviews.title: Taking away features every update
reviews.text: I recently updated the app and it seems EVERYTHING that used to be free is now behind a paywall. Specifically the natal chart, the daily horoscope, and aspect timing information, all which used to be FREE. Previously, there was not any timing info for sun and moon (fast moving so ok) but recently they have also added Mercury and Venus to not show any timing as well. Why???? Extremely frustrating as I now have to use another app to figure out the timing. Every time I have to do that, it is making me not want to use this app ever again.

reviews.title: I’m Not paying to see my birth chart and daily horoscopes
reviews.text: All of a sudden I have to pay to see ANYTHING about my own birth chart and daily horoscopes when those were the only things I used in the app.

reviews.title: I love this app BUT..
reviews.text: I LOVEEE this app and have been using it for over a year now, but recently it’s been crashing whenever I try to access my charts. Sometimes it works, but most of the time it takes multiple tries and it usually just keeps crashing. It’s especially frustrating because everything is behind a paywall. If I paid money to access certain charts that I can easily just get online, I should be able to look at them. I paid for the convenience of not having to retype in all the information I need for a birth chart, but I’m just not getting it. Please fix this devs it’s seriously an awful issue.

reviews.title: Time to delete this app
reviews.text: You guys took away every feature that I used this app for one by one. Not sticking around for you to make me pay for what everyone else gives out for free thanks for ruining this with your greed

reviews.title: great app! but...
reviews.text: i used to be able to see my birth chart for free!! but now its a paid feature. i didn't mind the other features being paid because those aren't necessary but being able to view your birth chart and it's information should be the bare minimum for an astrology app!!

reviews.title: SCAM
reviews.text: I paid for a pro membership in Sept 2024, it was a one time fee, not monthly. Now all of a sudden it says I am a “free” user and continuously prompts me to upgrade to a monthly Pro membership. When I try to restore my Pro membership, it does not work. ABSOLUTE SCAM.

reviews.title: I used to love this app, but now it’s terrible
reviews.text: I did the one time payment for the ability to make unlimited charts a couple years ago, with the understanding this would be a good long term investment and I could use it long term. Been slowly adding more charts. Then just like that, they take away my ability to add charts and now require a subscription that’s double the price MONTHLY. For something they’d been providing for years without additional charge. I didn’t get a refund either, just lost my money and my charts. Genuinely scammy and greedy app, used to be great.

reviews.title: New layout is terrible
reviews.text: The app is now ruined , the old app was perfect , smooth UI, has now transitioned into this inaccurate mess … what a shame, going to need to find a different app

reviews.title: Can’t see anything without paying
reviews.text: I just signed up and entered my birth data. Then my profile showed completely different date/time than what I entered. I corrected it then tried to look at my birth chart and daily horoscope. I can’t see either without paying $1 for each one.

reviews.title: The app won't let me log in
reviews.text: After nearly using this app for three years and spending real money, it logged me out one random day. Now it won't let me log back in. I click "forgot password" and it just takes me to a seperate page that says "open in time passages?" Then when I click yes it takes me directly back to the login screen I can't get into in the first place. Please fix. I tell everyone I know that likes astrology about this app but I can't even use it rn. Also, I wish it would just keep me logged in.

reviews.title: Pay to update my chart
reviews.text: I made an error was selecting my birthday and when I went back to change it, I would have to purchase a new chart. I miss one. Everything wasn’t a fee.

reviews.title: KEEPS CRASHING

reviews.title: Greed
reviews.text: Suddenly change the app to force users to pay for daily chart readings and natal charts is messed up. Greedy. Will not be using this app any longer.

reviews.title: Loved this app before the change
reviews.text: This was my go-to astrology app for yeaaaaarrrssss. I purchased the unlimited chart generator feature, and it was so worth the money. With the recent update to a subscription-based model, they no longer honor this purchase, which is super disappointing. This was one of the last apps I used regularly that wasn’t switching to monthly payments, which I really appreciated, but that is no longer the case. Sad that this is the case.

reviews.title: don’t listen to them lie
reviews.text: You do have to pay money for your daily horoscope and chart. they are coming on here replying saying “it’s not how it should be” but it is. not worth it.

reviews.title: I Miss the Old App
reviews.text: Ever since they updated to the new app I have no access to my old account that I paid $30 for. Further, ‘daily horoscopes’ has never worked for me. I can’t log in because when I try to get a password reset link, it just sends me around in circles.

reviews.title: Making me pay for an app that doesn’t work
reviews.text:
Extremely unhappy with this new version of Time Passages, which I now have to pay for. IT CAN’T FIND WASHINGTON, DC as a birth location. I start typing and the name pops up, but when I select it, a message says that it can’t find it. I go to the built-in atlas and find it there, and again when I select it, a note pops up saying it can’t be found. 
VERY UNHAPPY, DEVS, TO BE RIPPED OFF IN THIS WAY. Can I get my money back???
UTA: I saw the developer response. As my review states, I did try using the atlas, but again, when I find DC and tap on it to select, the app says it can’t be found. 
Not loving any aspect of the new app. The purple background is ugly, and it won’t sync my dozens of charts from the legacy app. The old version was perfectly fine. This is a good example of “updating” something not to improve it, but to change it just for the sake of having something different. Not better, just different, and with less functionality.

reviews.title: I loved this app until now…
reviews.text:
Update March 2026: I canceled my subscription. Frankly, the treatment of legacy users is nothing short of despicable. I already discussed how much I despise the scam that is Software As A Service, but now let’s talk about customer care.

To say it was a joke would be putting it kindly. They have disregarded the feedback they received from many of us who merely wanted what we had originally paid for. Their new app is terrible. It is not nearly as user friendly nor is it as intuitive. The emails I received in reply to my feedback essentially said, “We’re sorry you’re choosing to focus on the negative. You got a free trial! We don’t care about retaining your business because you won’t be making us enough money.”

It was great while it lasted, but you don’t need subscriptions for everything. I’m going back to… books. Yep. Books. No one can take physical copies from you, alter them, etc. and that, friends, is now priceless. 
—
I am a legacy user. I paid a flat fee in 2012 and have happily been using TimePassages as my go-to astrology app. I get that things change, but I hate software as a service. Worked for a firm that did it. Despised it. That would be one thing, but it’s been months, the year is almost over and I STILL can’t migrate my legacy charts to this new app. Also, I’m finding it interesting that whilst playing with the new app my compatibility score with someone that has been what it is for 12 years is now suddenly different on the new app. I can get behind change, but

reviews.title: Decade Long Customer Already Paid
reviews.text: I paid years ago for all the features on this app. I have 128 birth charts in here and always used this app, it was always better and more technical and comprehensive than other apps. Now the App is money hungry making folks pay for many features and they’ve lost my loyalty and usage due to not honoring what I’ve already paid for. This is a digital hoax. Imagine having paid for a tv years ago just to have someone barge into your home take it and tell you to pay again? Just because this is digital technology does not mean it’s appropriate. I am utterly upset as this is robbery and you sneakily try to act like it’s okay. Beyond disappointed as this is scamming and yall are trying to use other language to act like that’s not what’s occurring to your loyal customers and past users. Do better. Give us our features back.

reviews.title: Regressed design
reviews.text:
The latest version is not as good as the previous, most notably the flat white iconography (in dark mode).  Previously there was more color coding of the planets in the planet portion allowing for visual perception of clusters and correlations.  Now the presentation is just walls of white text.  Which feels more messy and disorganized, even though it was probably thought of as a cleaner simpler design. 

Buttons and skeuomorphism have very real utility and visual value.

The white on purple esthetic is also not very fun or thematically immersive considering the rich history of style and design celebrating Astrology. 

The app looks cheaper and like a rushed job they outsourced to someone who just ran off with the money without giving it any design language. 

It’s like as drab and boring as microsoft word… 

Also the social media login prompt that pops up at the start of the app is clearly in poor taste for anyone living in the 21st century.  

You don’t do popups, and you don’t force yourself on peoples social media. We live in an age of consent, that nonsense doesn’t fly anymore. If I didn’t already have the app installed I would of walked away at the very start. 

I like the app overall, I tapped past the new popup,  even though it looked like a intrusive requirement. 

What I liked most was the color coded planet view which is now gone. So the value of the app has dropped to basic info.

reviews.title: The changes have made this app garbage
reviews.text:
I’m a professional astrologer. I have used the time passages app as my primary astrology tool on my phone for years, I had the old pro version and recommended the app to everyone. Since the migration, I have lost the LIFETIME pro access I paid for. When migrating to the new platform, I lost hundreds of charts that are still on my online account but even after working with customer support for weeks, they are unable to help and the only way to resolve the issue is for me to manually go in and re-enter all of the details- which creates duplicates on the online account. 
I’m curious what exactly I’m supposed to be paying monthly for? Bc it’s not customer service and it’s definitely not a better platform or even just continued access to what I already had. I just built my own app that looks and functions exactly like time passages, without the headache or the monthly fee.
